mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USERS ( LOGIN_ID, PASSWORD, NICKNAME, EMAIL, FAVORITE_TEAM_ID, ROLE_CODE, POINT, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{loginId}, #{password}, #{nickname}, #{email}, #{favoriteTeamId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, NVL(#{roleCode, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 1), NVL(#{point, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 100), SYSTIMESTAMP )
INSERT INTO USER_PREDICTS ( USER_ID, PREDICT_WIN, PREDICT_TOTAL, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{userId}, 0, 0, SYSTIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT u.USER_ID, u.LOGIN_ID, u.PASSWORD, u.NICKNAME, u.EMAIL, u.FAVORITE_TEAM_ID, u.ROLE_CODE, u.POINT, u.CREATED_AT, u.UPDATED_AT, r.ROLE_NAME, t.TEAM_NAME AS FAVORITE_TEAM_NAME, t.TEAM_NAME_KOR AS FAVORITE_TEAM_NAME_KOR, t.EMBLEM_URL AS FAVORITE_TEAM_EMBLEM_URL FROM USERS u LEFT JOIN USER_ROLES r ON u.ROLE_CODE = r.ROLE_CODE LEFT JOIN TEAMS t ON u.FAVORITE_TEAM_ID = t.TEAM_ID WHERE u.LOGIN_ID = #{loginId}

SELECT u.USER_ID, u.LOGIN_ID, u.PASSWORD, u.NICKNAME, u.EMAIL, u.FAVORITE_TEAM_ID, u.ROLE_CODE, u.POINT, u.CREATED_AT, u.UPDATED_AT, r.ROLE_NAME, t.TEAM_NAME AS FAVORITE_TEAM_NAME, t.TEAM_NAME_KOR AS FAVORITE_TEAM_NAME_KOR, t.EMBLEM_URL AS FAVORITE_TEAM_EMBLEM_URL FROM USERS u LEFT JOIN USER_ROLES r ON u.ROLE_CODE = r.ROLE_CODE LEFT JOIN TEAMS t ON u.FAVORITE_TEAM_ID = t.TEAM_ID WHERE u.USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE USERS SET NICKNAME = #{nickname}, EMAIL = #{email}, FAVORITE_TEAM_ID = #{favoriteTeamId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
UPDATE USERS SET PASSWORD = #{newPassword}, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM AI_MATCHES WHERE HOME_TEAM_ID IN (SELECT CUSTOM_TEAM_ID FROM CUSTOM_TEAMS WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}) OR AWAY_TEAM_ID IN (SELECT CUSTOM_TEAM_ID FROM CUSTOM_TEAMS WHERE USER_ID = #{userId})
DELETE FROM CUSTOM_SQUADS WHERE CUSTOM_TEAM_ID IN (SELECT CUSTOM_TEAM_ID FROM CUSTOM_TEAMS WHERE USER_ID = #{userId})
mapper.update: UPDATE USERS SET LOGIN_ID = SUBSTR('wd_' || USER_ID || '_' || LOGIN_ID, 1, 50), NICKNAME = '(탈퇴회원#' || USER_ID || ')', EMAIL = SUBSTR('wd_' || USER_ID || '_' || EMAIL, 1, 100), PASSWORD = '*WITHDRAWN*', ROLE_CODE = 7, POINT = 0, FAVORITE_TEAM_ID = NULL, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT p.POST_ID, p.USER_ID, u.NICKNAME, p.TEAM_ID, COALESCE(t.TEAM_NAME_KOR, t.TEAM_NAME) AS TEAM_NAME, p.CATEGORY_ID, c.CATEGORY_TYPE, p.TITLE, p.VIEW_COUNT, p.LIKE_COUNT, p.IS_BLIND, p.IS_DELETED, p.CREATED_AT, p.UPDATED_AT, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMMENTS cm WHERE cm.POST_ID = p.POST_ID AND cm.IS_DELETED = 'N' ) AS COMMENT_COUNT FROM POSTS p JOIN USERS u ON u.USER_ID = p.USER_ID JOIN CATEGORY c ON c.CATEGORY_ID = p.CATEGORY_ID LEFT JOIN TEAMS t ON t.TEAM_ID = p.TEAM_ID WHERE p.USER_ID = #{userId} AND p.IS_DELETED = 'N' ORDER BY p.CREATED_AT DESC, p.POST_ID DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM POSTS WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND IS_DELETED = 'N'

SELECT c.COMMENT_ID, c.POST_ID, c.USER_ID, u.NICKNAME, c.P_COMMENT_ID, c.CONTENT, c.IS_BLIND, c.IS_DELETED, c.CREATED_AT, c.UPDATED_AT, p.TITLE AS POST_TITLE, p.VIEW_COUNT AS VIEW_COUNT, cat.CATEGORY_TYPE, COALESCE(t.TEAM_NAME_KOR, t.TEAM_NAME) AS TEAM_NAME, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMMENT_LIKES cl WHERE cl.COMMENT_ID = c.COMMENT_ID ) AS LIKE_COUNT FROM COMMENTS c JOIN USERS u ON u.USER_ID = c.USER_ID JOIN POSTS p ON p.POST_ID = c.POST_ID JOIN CATEGORY cat ON cat.CATEGORY_ID = p.CATEGORY_ID LEFT JOIN TEAMS t ON t.TEAM_ID = p.TEAM_ID WHERE c.USER_ID = #{userId} AND c.IS_DELETED = 'N' ORDER BY c.CREATED_AT DESC, c.COMMENT_ID DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMMENTS WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND IS_DELETED = 'N'

SELECT p.POST_ID, p.USER_ID, author.NICKNAME, p.TEAM_ID, COALESCE(t.TEAM_NAME_KOR, t.TEAM_NAME) AS TEAM_NAME, p.CATEGORY_ID, c.CATEGORY_TYPE, p.TITLE, p.VIEW_COUNT, p.LIKE_COUNT, p.IS_BLIND, p.IS_DELETED, p.CREATED_AT, p.UPDATED_AT, TO_CHAR(pl.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS LIKED_AT, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMMENTS cm WHERE cm.POST_ID = p.POST_ID AND cm.IS_DELETED = 'N' ) AS COMMENT_COUNT FROM POST_LIKES pl JOIN POSTS p ON p.POST_ID = pl.POST_ID JOIN USERS author ON author.USER_ID = p.USER_ID JOIN CATEGORY c ON c.CATEGORY_ID = p.CATEGORY_ID LEFT JOIN TEAMS t ON t.TEAM_ID = p.TEAM_ID WHERE pl.USER_ID = #{userId} AND p.IS_DELETED = 'N' ORDER BY pl.CREATED_AT DESC, p.POST_ID DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM POST_LIKES pl JOIN POSTS p ON p.POST_ID = pl.POST_ID WHERE pl.USER_ID = #{userId} AND p.IS_DELETED = 'N'

SELECT ph.POINT_HISTORY_ID, ph.USER_ID, ph.PREDICTION_ID, ph.AMOUNT, ph.BALANCE_AFTER, ph.DESCRIPTION, ph.CREATED_AT FROM POINT_HISTORY ph WHERE ph.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY ph.CREATED_AT DESC, ph.POINT_HISTORY_ID DESC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SHOP_ITEMS ( ITEM_TYPE, ITEM_NAME, DESCRIPTION, POINT, IMAGE_URL, IS_ACTIVE, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{itemType}, #{itemName}, #{description}, #{point}, #{imageUrl}, 'Y', SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT ITEM_ID AS "itemId", ITEM_TYPE AS "itemType", ITEM_NAME AS "itemName", DESCRIPTION AS "description", POINT AS "point", IMAGE_URL AS "imageUrl" FROM SHOP_ITEMS WHERE ITEM_NAME = #{itemName} FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT ui.INVENTORY_ID AS "inventoryId", ui.ITEM_ID AS "itemId", si.ITEM_TYPE AS "itemType", si.ITEM_NAME AS "itemName", si.DESCRIPTION AS "description", si.POINT AS "point", si.IMAGE_URL AS "imageUrl", ui.IS_EQUIPPED AS "isEquipped", TO_CHAR(ui.PURCHASED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "purchasedAt" FROM USER_INVENTORY ui JOIN SHOP_ITEMS si ON si.ITEM_ID = ui.ITEM_ID WHERE ui.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY ui.PURCHASED_AT DESC, ui.INVENTORY_ID DESC

SELECT io.ORDER_ID AS "orderId", io.ITEM_ID AS "itemId", si.ITEM_TYPE AS "itemType", si.ITEM_NAME AS "itemName", si.DESCRIPTION AS "description", io.POINT AS "point", si.IMAGE_URL AS "imageUrl", io.ORDER_STATUS AS "orderStatus", TO_CHAR(io.ORDERED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "orderedAt" FROM ITEM_ORDERS io JOIN SHOP_ITEMS si ON si.ITEM_ID = io.ITEM_ID WHERE io.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY io.ORDERED_AT DESC, io.ORDER_ID DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USER_INVENTORY ( USER_ID, ITEM_ID, IS_EQUIPPED, PURCHASED_AT ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{itemId}, 'N', SYSDATE )
INSERT INTO ITEM_ORDERS ( ORDER_ID, USER_ID, ITEM_ID, POINT, ORDER_STATUS, ORDERED_AT ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{userId}, #{itemId}, #{point}, 'COMPLETED', SYSDATE )

INSERT INTO POINT_TRANSACTIONS ( USER_ID, TX_TYPE, AMOUNT, BALANCE_AFTER, ORDER_ID, DESCRIPTION, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{userId}, 'SPEND', #{amount}, #{balanceAfter}, #{orderId}, #{description}, SYSDATE )
INSERT INTO POINT_HISTORY ( USER_ID, PREDICTION_ID, AMOUNT, BALANCE_AFTER, CREATED_AT, DESCRIPTION ) VALUES ( #{userId}, NULL, #{amount}, #{balanceAfter}, SYSTIMESTAMP, #{description} )
